```{r,echo=F,warning=F}
options(scipen=99)
P = sample(11:99,1)/10*10^(sample(1:3,1))
k = round(runif(1,1.01,1.09),4)
r = k-1
t = sample(3:20,1)
A = P*k^t
```

Question
========

An investment is purchased at a principal of `r P` USD. Every year its worth **increases** by `r r*100`%. In USD, what will its worth be after `r t` years?

(The tolerance is $\pm 0.01$ USD.)


Solution
========

$$`r P`\cdot `r k`^{`r t`}~=~`r round(A,2)`$$


Meta-information
============
extype: num
exsolution: `r A`
exname: repeat_inc
extol: 0.01
